summary: Landing site for a launched iOS / Android app: phone mockups in the hero, a feature walkthrough where the phone screen changes as you scroll, a hands-on planner or plan tabs, store reviews, pricing for in-app plans, a download page and, for apps that hold money or personal data, a security page. Works for playful consumer apps and calm, trust-first finance or utility apps.

pages.purpose: Show the app on a phone, what it does in a few screens, that people rate it well, and get a download.

sections.purpose: Promise, store badges and one or two phones showing the main screen.
alternatives: media-text: a calm split hero (promise, two actions, store rating) beside the app shown as stacked glass panes, for trust-first apps
fields: Store rating with source and review count
Main app screens (real screenshots or token-drawn screens)
Up to three headline figures with source
sections.notes: Phones can be drawn from tokens (rounded body, status bar, screen slot) so screens re-theme; phone art is role=img with a label describing the screen. Use official store badge artwork and follow its usage rules.

sections.purpose: Text-only trust seals right under the hero: licence, protection, ratings, each claim with its proof.
fields: Per seal: claim and proof underneath (licence number, regulator, audit, rating source)
sections.notes: Use for finance, health-data or security-sensitive apps. No third-party logos unless licensed; each line must stand on its own.

sections.purpose: Feature chapters beside a sticky phone whose screen swaps as each chapter crosses the middle of the viewport; a numbered rail jumps to a chapter.
alternatives: feature-grid: a simpler grid of features when there are no distinct screens per feature
tabs: screens switched by tabs instead of scroll
fields: Per feature: title, two or three points, the matching app screen
sections.notes: Under about 64rem repeat the phone inside each chapter instead of sticking. Reduced motion: screens swap without sliding.

sections.purpose: Measured results or usage figures.
fields: Per figure: value, unit, label, source and period

sections.purpose: A hands-on piece: plan tabs with a synced phone screen (one tab per programme / plan), or a planner where sliders change a live projection chart.
alternatives: area-chart: a goal or savings planner (pick a goal, set an amount and a horizon, see the projection month by month and the month the goal is reached)
line-chart: a projection with a target line
fields: Plans / programmes with phases and a week-by-week overview
Or: planner inputs, ranges, formula and an illustrative rate with its disclaimer
sections.notes: Planner result in an aria-live region with a text summary of the final amount; rates shown as illustrative and dated.

sections.purpose: Store reviews or one customer story.
fields: Reviews with author name, store and rating (with permission)
Overall rating and count with source

sections.purpose: Short FAQ on the home page (fees, devices, data).
Download band with store links.
alternatives: qr-code: a QR to the store page for desktop visitors

pages.purpose: In-app plans with a monthly / yearly switch, the comparison and billing or fee questions.

sections.purpose: Pricing headline and what the free plan includes.
Plans with monthly / yearly prices.
fields: Plan names, prices per period, features, highlighted plan
How to cancel through the store

sections.purpose: Feature-by-feature comparison.
fields: Feature rows and value per plan

sections.purpose: Billing, store subscriptions, fees and limits.

pages.purpose: Get the app: store links, device requirements, first-run steps and the full FAQ.

sections.purpose: Store badges and requirements per platform.
fields: Minimum OS version and download size per platform

sections.purpose: Three setup steps after installing.
fields: Per step: title and one sentence

sections.purpose: The full FAQ.

pages.purpose: For apps holding money or personal data: layers of protection with proofs, recent service health, what to do when a phone is lost, how to report a vulnerability.

sections.purpose: Security promise.
Layers of protection, each with its proof.
fields: Per layer: what protects the user and the proof (licence, audit, standard)

sections.purpose: Recent service health per part of the app.
fields: Services and their uptime over recent days

sections.purpose: Steps to take when the phone is lost or stolen.
fields: Steps and the support line to call

sections.purpose: Vulnerability reporting.

content: App Store and Google Play links, ratings and review counts
Real app screenshots for the hero and each feature
Feature list grouped into chapters with one screen each
Plans / programmes or planner inputs and formula (with illustrative-rate disclaimer)
In-app plan prices, trial length and cancellation path
For regulated apps: licence, regulator, protection scheme and the required legal notes for the footer
Security measures with proofs and a vulnerability contact

styles.name: dark energetic glass
styles.why: Sport, habit and lifestyle apps: near-black, an electric accent, a hero that draws itself, quick on its feet.

styles.name: calm trusted light
styles.why: Finance, savings and utility apps: light glass over a soft tinted scene, mono figures, spacious; trust before excitement.

pitfalls: Fake or unlicensed store badges and device frames; use the official artwork and its rules.
Phone screens as unlabelled images; label each with what the screen shows.
Scroll-driven phones that break on small screens or under reduced motion; repeat screens inline and swap without animation.
Projections and interest rates presented as promises; label them illustrative, date them and add the regulatory disclaimer.
Regulated apps missing licence / regulator details or deposit-protection wording in the footer.
Ratings and review quotes without source, count and date.
Prices that differ from the in-store price or omit how to cancel a store subscription.
